decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet builds directly on the firm's core pharmaceutical formulation and regulatory knowledge, and it has a dedicated page, so the firm can interpret early results and refine it within its existing competence.

A generic antidepressant capsule draws on established generic-drug know-how that the firm can readily absorb and apply, and after the heavy registration investment it is unlikely to be withdrawn after only one year.

The combination antihypertensive film tablet fits closely with the firm's existing tablet manufacturing and cardiovascular knowledge, which supports learning from market feedback rather than withdrawal.

The dietary supplement lies further from the firm's core pharmaceutical knowledge base and is only mentioned on the website, which makes it a weaker fit, but supplement lines are cheap to maintain, so it will likely stay for now.
